variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Variables are immutable by default. Use 'mut' to make them mutable.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Strictly typed with a clear distinction between owned (String) and borrowed (&str) data.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Similar to C/C++, but enforces strict type matching for operators.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: 'if' is an expression that can return a value. 'match' provides exhaustive pattern matching.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Iterates over iterators, offering safe and bounded access to collections.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Supports 'while' and an unconditional 'loop' which is often used for retries.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Requires explicit parameter and return types. Implicit return on the last expression.

arrays.title: Arrays & Vectors
arrays.notes: Arrays are fixed-size; Vectors are heap-allocated and growable.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: HashMap retrieval returns an Option, forcing the developer to handle missing keys.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Uses Result<T, E> for recoverable errors, paired with the powerful ? operator for early returns.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Rust provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Rust supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Rust provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Rust converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Rust represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Rust formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Rust branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Rust defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Rust iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Rust organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Rust stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Rust groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Rust tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Rust organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
